findings.summary: Learnability proof was too generic and did not force the full correction-to-rollback lifecycle.
findings.required_fix: Add AI output/correction -> DPO -> privacy/source/license -> user-local store -> approval packet -> continue-training from existing checkpoint -> fresh-load -> source-disjoint held-out/ablation -> no memorization -> rollback gates.

findings.summary: Plan did not require separate learnability evidence for PromptToTask, OrchestrationReasoning, and SkillSelection.
findings.required_fix: Add per-machine evidence rows with DPO target, local/common separation, continue-training proof, fresh-load/held-out proof, and ablation/no-memorization proof.

findings.summary: Review ledger row 6 was ledger-only PASS without an evidence packet.
findings.required_fix: Create review-pass-06.md/json and update REVIEW.jsonl row 6 with ledger_rows_are_evidence=false.

recheck_evidence: Plan now states the full local learnability chain from host AI output/correction through rollback.
Plan now separates private/user-local adaptive store from common repo training and requires source/license/redaction review before common use.
Plan now requires backup/export/import/share evidence for user-local adaptive store.
Plan now requires continue-training to load existing checkpoints for PromptToTaskMachine, OrchestrationReasoningMachine, and SkillSelectionMachine.
Plan now forbids retrain-from-zero unless explicitly approved and labelled cold-start.
Plan now requires fresh-load through the public machine boundary and source-disjoint held-out/ablation controls.
Plan now requires per-machine learnability evidence instead of a generic local-model row.
Review row 6 now points to review-pass-06.md/json and marks ledger_rows_are_evidence=false.
